name: How Much More Do Custom Cabinets Cost?

mainEntity.name: How much do custom cabinets change the cost of a kitchen remodel in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: How much do custom cabinets change the cost of a kitchen remodel in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets usually increase both cost and lead time because they are designed and built for a specific kitchen rather than ordered in standard sizes. That can be a major advantage in awkward layouts or high-end projects, but it also raises the budget compared with stock or semi-custom options. In Los Angeles County, custom work can be especially valuable when the home has unusual dimensions or the owner wants a highly tailored look. The contractor should separate cabinet pricing from installation labor so you can see exactly where the cost difference comes from. You should also ask about fabrication lead time, finish options, hardware, and whether any design revisions after approval will add charges. Since countertops depend on cabinet installation and templating, custom cabinets can also lengthen the total project timeline. If you want the custom look without full custom pricing, ask whether semi-custom cabinets with upgraded fronts or fillers could achieve a similar result. The right choice depends on the room layout, the level of personalization you want, and how much schedule flexibility you have.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets usually raise the project cost significantly because they are built to fit exact dimensions and design choices. They also often add fabrication time and can affect the schedule for templating, installation, and countertop work. A contractor should price them separately from standard cabinets.
